<!--
Conventions: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md (this repo's issue tracker is
GitHub Issues; `gh issue create --title "..." --body "..."` to file one)
and docs/agents/triage-labels.md (the five-role label vocabulary — this
template defaults to `needs-triage`; a maintainer will re-label after
evaluation: `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, or
`wontfix`).

Larger, multi-issue efforts belong in Atelier as a PRD
(`prds/<NAME>-PRD.md`), not as a single GitHub issue — this template is for
a right-sized, single-issue feature or task. For a Wayfinder map spanning
several child issues, use a `wayfinder:map` issue with linked sub-issues
or task-list `Blocked by:` lines instead of this template.
-->
